title: Seat comfort and easy entry
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly discuss comfort, especially seat comfort, overall ride feel, and ease of getting in and out of the vehicle.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the seats and cabin as very comfortable and also note easy entry and exit for some drivers.

negative.summary: Negative reviews say the seats or overall seating experience are uncomfortable, but the examples are limited.

mixed.summary: Mixed reviews describe comfortable entry and smooth driving but compare the vehicle unfavorably on comfort against other luxury models or mention comfort alongside other needs.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention comfort without enough context to tell whether the customer is praising or criticizing it.

limitations: The sampled fragments are heavily dominated by short statements about comfort, so specific seat features or body-area support details are often missing.
Some example text compares comfort with other vehicles, which makes the topic slightly heterogeneous across absolute comfort and relative comfort judgments.
Undetermined examples are sparse in the sample, so their exact context is not clear.
